quest.title: Team Rigor, or Team Intuition?
quest.description: You discover two treasure hunters out on the Barrowmoss Barrens who are at a loss as to how they might operate a certain large machine...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.text: Yup, that's how we do it! Attaboy, that's it!
Success on your first try — you really are something else, Anezka!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's the intuition institution for you, Macola! ... Say, I think I see people coming this way!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: And speaking of that, Drzislav's really outdone himself, too! Forty-plus pages just to introduce each component, my word!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Right? Slava's the best at naming stuff amongst us, too! Still, why don't you put your stuff down and go see to our guests?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: #Why hello there, {M#my handsome sir}{F#my lovely lady}. Care for a little game with our dear Bobik?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bobik...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not what you're calling this giant machine, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Spot on! This is <color=#00E1FFFF>Bobik-131</color>, civilian all-terrain transportation device, and our buddy Drzislav's pride and joy!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: It's just that reading the instructions he left behind gives me a headache... Uh, from the knowledge boost, I mean! Trust me, I'll have a brain as good as any scientist's in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Then we'll have Macola's skills, Slava's brains, and my intuition — we'll never have to worry about commission bounties ever again! Isn't that right, Bobik?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Bobik makes a "Beep clank — boom!" noise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yikes! Careful, {NICKNAME}, or we'll get squished!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Oh, don't worry, Bobik's a good kid, he won't hurt you!

choices.text: Very reassuring...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry, how is that reassuring in any way? Paimon sure doesn't see it.

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: But operating giant robots is so much fun! Sure, Bobik does have a shocking appearance, but he's awesome once you get the hang of the controls!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait, so you mean it's fun? Hmm... Paimon might wanna give it a go too... What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: We'll try our hand at the big robot, of course!

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Nice, that's plus two playmates for Bobik! But before that, I have a very important question to ask you...

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: When operating such large machines, are you the type to rigorously dig through the instruction manual, or will you immediately turn the machine on and use the intuition within your soul to feel it out?

choices.text: I'm in the Rigor Brigade.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Part of a rare breed, I see! Drzislav would have been thrilled to meet you! Unfortunately, as for the relevant documentation... I'm sorry, he told me a thousand times not to show it to anyone!

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Well, Anezka did just get the hang of Bobik's movement mechanisms... That said, he was primarily designed to transport large amounts of goods.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: And... we've got no clue as to how to make him do that just yet. With your help, though, I suspect I won't have to waste time going through all these documents.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: There's a ton of big boxes we no longer use around here. Try guiding Bobik to arrange them in interesting shapes!

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: Yup! Go on, feel Bobik in your bones, with your soul — I know you can!

choices.text: I'm in the Intuition Squad.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Much like Anezka, then! Bet you're amazing, too — though that leaves me the last rigorous soul standing, to chew on the documents alone... Ah, I knew the path to becoming a scientist was one of solitude.

choices.text: I'm on Team Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And what team is that supposed to be? Ugh, you make Paimon's head hurt... And what was that we were saying about headaches being a sign that you're getting smarter? Nope, not getting that either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But alright, since you're on Paimon's team, Paimon gets to set the rules! Please learn how to control Bobik properly. You'll endanger us all otherwise...

choices.text: It should be safer if I handle this, I think.
"Don't worry" might be a big ask...

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: The lab's down there — and those bad guys who kidnapped Bobik, too.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Task Force
dialogues.text: Madam Allochka, the equipment has been retrieved. We are preparing the modifications as per your instructions.

dialogues.speaker: Allochka
dialogues.text: Hmph. What did I say? Can't ever trust scientists. The second they think they've grasped some "truth," they believe themselves above the law, above order, free to do as they please.

dialogues.speaker: Allochka
dialogues.text: Turning such a powerful weapon — capable of rewriting the script of a battle — into a civilian transportation vehicle... Is this some kind of joke? About principles and the need to stick to them? Or are they just running from the power they might wield?

dialogues.speaker: Allochka
dialogues.text: It's a pity the world doesn't turn on wishful thinking. Power must be used wisely, not frittered away on meaningless posturing.

dialogues.speaker: Allochka
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Landrover. You will soon have the power that should always have been yours to command.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Ugh! Looks like they're about to do something to poor Bobik...

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: How dare they! We can rush in now, right? Right!?

choices.text: Let's get Bobik back!

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: That's right! We've gotta teach them a lesson they won't soon forget!

choices.text: Bobik is a *civilian* all-terrain transportation device!

talks.objective: Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: You're pretty good — no wonder Bobik's taken a shine to you!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: And no wonder Anezka's got her eye on you — you're amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No wonder... Wait a minute, when did Paimon get roped into your cheerleader club? Ugh, must have something to do with those puppy-dog eyes, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, you did just... figure out how Bobik works without getting anyone hurt. That *is* pretty impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Also, don't you think the arrangement of these boxes has some real artistry to it?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: A work of art installed by a civilian all-terrain transportation device... Is that what people call "installation art"?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Wait, is that what that means? I never really got it before, but now that you've explained it this way, I totally do!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's... not what the term means.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, and you can say we're subject matter experts on that, being part of the "Alliance of Artists to Overthrow the Evil Organization and Protect the Future of Fontaine" and all!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Wow, that's an awesome name, alright! So artists join the battle against evil organizations, too?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Oh, how I'd love to join up! But I haven't created any art yet... Guess I'll just have to start today!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: A scientist's mind with an artist's tastes... There could be no better candidate. Don't you think so, Anezka?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: You bet I do! Well then, please help us turn the rest of the boxes into lovely works of art!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so there are other boxes? Hmm, these two might be a safety hazard if left alone to handle all of 'em themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, time to enjoy "installing" some art!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Woohoo! I'll pitch in, too.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: You two go ahead first, then. Anezka, Bobik, and I will be right behind you!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: This is the place. We're not the best at what comes next, so we'll leave that to the real artists, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: You're pretty good — no wonder Bobik's taken a shine to you!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: And no wonder Anezka's got her eye on you — you're amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No wonder... Wait a minute, when did Paimon get roped into your cheerleader club? Ugh, must have something to do with those puppy-dog eyes, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, you did just... figure out how Bobik works without getting anyone hurt. That *is* pretty impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Also, don't you think the arrangement of these boxes has some real artistry to it?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: A work of art installed by a civilian all-terrain transportation device... Is that what people call "installation art"?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Wait, is that what that means? I never really got it before, but now that you've explained it this way, I totally do!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: A scientist's mind with an artist's tastes... There could be no better candidate. Don't you think so, Anezka?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: You bet I do! Well then, please help us turn the rest of the boxes into lovely works of art!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so there are other boxes? Hmm, these two might be a safety hazard if left alone to handle all of 'em themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, time to enjoy "installing" some art!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Woohoo! I'll pitch in, too.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: You two go ahead first, then. Anezka, Bobik, and I will be right behind you!

talks.objective: Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Wow, it's beautiful! Bobik seems to love it, too!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Let me see. Where should we go next...

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Task Force
dialogues.text: So that's where you were, huh? Real runaround you gave us there. The device in your possession is now property of the Fatui Task Force, so hand it over — and then scram. What follows is none of your business.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Sorry, who are these people? Acquaintances of yours?

choices.text: I thought you knew them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. Forget recognizing these chumps — we only have ballpark numbers on Fatui we've handed knuckle sandwiches out to during our travels as a whole.

response.speaker: Fatui Task Force
response.text: Such insolence. Still, we are not here to fight. Hand the Landrover over peaceably, and we'll consider overlooking your rudeness.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Landrover — wait, do they mean Bobik? But that's not what the scientist who created him said...

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: That's right. Slava told us in no uncertain terms that he'd only give us Bobik if we promised to only ever use him for civilian transportation.

response.speaker: Fatui Task Force
response.text: Drzislav? We hired Drzislav. Everything he created, we own. Even the names of said creations. He has no right to transfer ownership of anything involved.

response.speaker: Fatui Task Force
response.text: Just hand the Landrover over. We can even overlook Drzislav's theft of key assets and his absconding with them.

response.speaker: Fatui Task Force
response.text: You're Drzislav's friends, so I assume you're all smart enough to know who has greater authority here.

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: Sure we do, but Macola, have you ever seen anyone with poorer judgment?

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Oh, I'll say — Drzislav entrusted Bobik to us, so of course we've got to take good care of him.

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: Also, Bobik is just... the cutest! You know, like a little puppy!

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Yeah! I mean, puppies are puppies and humans are humans, and ne'er should the two be spoken of as the same creature. But you know, many pets are treasured as family nowadays.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: So how could we let strangers just take ours away?

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: Pre-cisely! And we're talking strangers who've decided someone else's kid is cute, gave that kid some weird name, and now want to take said kid away. What such people need isn't our cooperation, but a real stern lesson!

choices.text: Don't worry, we're not letting them take Bobik.

response.speaker: Fatui Task Force
response.text: Fine. Then you shall see who the Landrover's real owners are.

choices.text: Bobik is a *civilian* all-terrain transportation device!
I can just about tell these are Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: #Be nice, Bobik! {NICKNAME}'s a new friend!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: What she said! Be polite, would you?

talks.objective: Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Why'd you hold me back, Macola!? I wanted to give those lunkheads a piece of my mind, too!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Don't be mad, Anezka, don't be mad. We should pity such loveless folk — to go nigh insane with jealousy upon seeing two happy families bringing their cherished pets out to meet new friends.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh... Huh? Wait. "Two happy families bringing their cherished pets out to meet new friends"... Are you sayin' that Paimon's {NICKNAME}'s pet?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: #No, no, of course not! How could we get owner-pet relationships wrong? {NICKNAME} is very obviously your pet, right, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's not that... Wait, how did you come to such a wild conclusion?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Perfect features, lovely golden fur, a unique name... and let's not forget — the ability to get along great with Bobik upon your first meeting. I—I mean, if that isn't...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You two... Paimon's {NICKNAME}'s guide and companion, for goodness' sake! We're not owner and pet. Definitely not!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Ah, I see. Hmm. "Companions," you say... Yes, that does have a nicer ring to it. Don't you think so, Anezka?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Aye, so it does! That's settled, then. From now on, Bobik's our companion as well!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: And now that we've chased those brutes off, shall we continue making art as per our original plans? I'm sure that would make Bobik happy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: I did notice earlier that Bobik's got real artistic talent. Why, he was practically trembling with excitement while moving the boxes around.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: #Won't you come with us, Miss Guide, {NICKNAME}? I mean, we've teamed up to beat some baddies already, haven't we?

choices.text: Of course. Beating baddies is the best, let me tell you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You... Still, the Fatui aren't gonna just let this slide. You know that too, right? And things will get ugly if Bobik falls into their hands.

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: Bobik seemed kinda spooked just now as well. Macola and I need to check he's alright.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: There are still three box sites left. Do lead the way to them, Miss Guide. We'll meet up with you there.

choices.text: I've had lots of fun making art with you all.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location and continue to "install art"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After waiting for a while, you hear Bobik's footsteps heading your way.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location and continue to "install art"
Head to the designated location and continue to "install art"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Very soon, Anezka arrives with Bobik and Macola in tow.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location and continue to "install art"
Head to the designated location and continue to "install art"
Head to the designated location and continue to "install art"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Before long, Anezka and company arrive as agreed.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location and continue to "install art"
Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: That's our installation art complete, then? Not that I really understand it, of course... but it sure is pretty!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Of course, it's pretty. You took part in its creation, Anezka! Come now, we must take a photo to commemorate this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we're going to do that too?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Of course! It's a collaboration between us, after all. Let's find a spot with a beautiful view from which we can see every part of our installation art, and we'll take that picture there.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Excellent! And I'll see if I can get Bobik to strike some fabulous pose or another— Hang on a moment. Looks like something's happening over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's those guys from just now. They must be here for Bobik!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: What are those suspicious things flying around him?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Task Force
dialogues.text: Heh, worked a dream. Quickly, take the Landrover back to our garrison and hand it over to Lady Allochka. As for you meddling fools...

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: B—Bobik? Why are you... going with those villains... Didn't we just become companions?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They must've pulled some kind of dirty trick!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: We've got to catch up with them and get Bobik back!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Ugh! Outta the way, you pests!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: I'm curious. What sort of art will Bobik make?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: #Don't worry! With {NICKNAME} helping out, it'll be great no matter what it is!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Bobik! They're just up ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Task Force
dialogues.text: This is your final warning. Your little pet has now become a fearsome beast under Fatui command. Take another step, and it'll tear you to shreds.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: What have you done to Bobik!? Can't you hear? He's in so much pain! Let him go!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Task Force
dialogues.text: You hear that, Landrover? You're being let off the leash.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: I don't know much about art, but it's really pretty! Just a moment. Let me take it all in...

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Mm! It's growing on me for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After dodging the attack, you find that the Fatui have retreated into the laboratory.

dialogues.speaker: Unknown Voice
dialogues.text: *sigh* Silly me, how could I forget? That's right, you can flip this switch to restart the power. The control panel's frozen up again, I expect? Also, if you do want to reset Bobik, do remember to pick the backup program module up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That worked! Now we just need to find that backup program module, and we're golden!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: That voice just now — that was Drzislav! Fascinating. It was almost like he was in the room with us. He really is a genius scientist...

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Looks like he left himself a whole lot of reminder notes. That should make it easier for us to find clues, though, so thank goodness for his... terrible memory?

talks.objective: Discuss countermeasures with Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: *panting* ... Ugh... We were so close, but no dice...

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: This is bad. We're treasure hunters, not phantom thieves of any stripe. Getting doors open isn't our strong suit...

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: And knowing the kinda cautious fellow Drzislav was, the gate to the lab in which Bobik was produced and maintained is almost surely locked using some high-tech means. A frontal breach might be untenable...

choices.text: Did he leave you two any keys?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Right! He was your friend, and he did leave you Bobik, so he trusts you for sure. You should probably have the lab key, right?

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: I'm afraid not. We're good friends... insofar as downing eight mugs of alcohol together at The Flagship might form such bonds.

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: That's on you, Macola! If we had only grabbed one more drink, we would've become true friends for sure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Is that how good friends are made? In that case, we must be best buddies already, what with all the Fatui we've "downed"!

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: Haha... Well said, well said indeed! I knew you'd charge in alongside us to wrest Bobik from their grubby paws!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we haven't figured out *how* we're rushing in yet, have we?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The lab's gotta have ventilation ducts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's... a good point! It's a place where manufacturing and repairs are done. The people inside would choke to death if there were no vents... So let's head up above this cave and check, shall we?

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Speaking of that, there *was* a huge racket coming from that area not too long ago... Now that I think about it, was that them trying to break into the lab?

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: I'll bet that was the case! No wonder Slava told us he'd run into some trouble and had to skip town for a bit. Let's go check it out, then!

choices.text: Is there any other route we can take?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. Drzislav was your friend, and he did leave you Bobik, so he trusts you for sure. Did'ja hear about any secret passages from him, or something?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Looks like there's a huge box blocking the entrance to the cavern.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: That wasn't there before... Looks like we're right above the lab. We just need to remove this box, and we'll be in!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Oh, if only you were with us right now, Bobik...

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: A box this size cannot be man-portable. Perhaps they flung it in place using a crane... That means we could <color=#00E1FFFF>remove it the exact same way</color>, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go see if we can find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Found it! This must be the backup program module!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Awesome! Just what I expected from a mind gifted in both science and art. According to the instructions, all we have to do is plug the backup program module into the console!

talks.objective: Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Well, that's an unexpected arrangement, alright!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Very creative indeed!

talks.objective: Restore Bobik to a normal state

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Macola! Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: We're all good! We've taken care of the Fatui, no sweat!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Nice! And I've found the control panel used to reprogram Bobik. I'll be honest, it seems pretty complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't use that yet, Anezka. Wait for us to—

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Sorry, what did you say? Couldn't quite hear you! Like I said, the panel looks too complicated, so I just pressed some buttons based on my intuition... and guess what? That stopped the program rewrite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—Thank goodness...

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: But, uh, while the rewrite did stop, the panel's all frozen — won't respond no matter what buttons I press. What do I do now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? Did you seriously just go crazy on that panel? What would you have done if you activated some kinda self-destruct instead!?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: D—Don't panic just yet. I'm sure the manual Drzislav left us mentions what to do in this situation somewhere. Just give me a moment...

choices.text: Nothing beats reading the instructions.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: I found it! "If program rewrite failure results in control panel freeze, manually restart energy source and connect <color=#00E1FFFF>backup program module</color> to the control panel"!

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: The restart should be quite easy, right? We just need to find something that looks like an on-off switch. But what is this "backup program module" again...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No worries, there's no wall {NICKNAME}'s intuition can't get us over!

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Indeed. Where instructions fail, intuition must carry the day! I, too, shall look and see if we've missed out on any clues.

choices.text: I've heard it said that "turning it off and on again" works.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh? Why hasn't Paimon heard this one before? Did you just... intuit it or something, {NICKNAME}?

talks.objective: Find the switch to reboot the power supply

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Don't be scared, Bobik. We'll protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Let me have a look at your front paws... Yup, everything seems normal!

talks.objective: Find the switch to reboot the power supply
Insert the backup program module into the console with Macola

dialogues.speaker: Drzislav's Voice
dialogues.text: It appears you have found the backup program module — in which case, let's get started! Let's hope the process goes smoothly, or... Well, that'll be a headache, won't it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bobik, come back to us! Return to being the civilian all-terrain transportation device you were meant to be!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Come back to us, Bobik! You're Drzislav's pride and joy, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: You're our good friend, Bobik! Please, come back to us!

dialogues.speaker: Drzislav's Voice
dialogues.text: Backup program module input successful. Don't forget — you can manually input other parameters here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Manually input? What does that mean?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: The instructions state that any manual parameter inputs will be inscribed on Bobik's underlying systems. That said, wouldn't setting him to default do just fine?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Wait! Does that mean that Bobik will follow any parameters we sneak in here loyally and to the letter...?

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: In that case, could we write: "Bobik shall honor Anezka as queen of all Teyvat, and swear to defend Anezka and Macola with his life, for we three are the best of friends, never to be parted"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't do that! Bobik might malfunction if we put that many weird commands into him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Shall we have {NICKNAME} make the decision? {M#He}{F#She} did find the backup module, after all.

choices.text: Nothing needs to be added.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. Paimon thinks that's for the best as well. Let Bobik just be Bobik!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alrighty! Parameters set — time to hit confirm!

response.speaker: Drzislav's Voice
response.text: Bobik-131, civilian all-terrain transportation device, activating!

choices.text: Bobik is humanity's best friend.

response.speaker: Anezka
response.text: Can't he be "Anezka's best friend," though? It's just a quick word switcheroo...

choices.text: Let's greatly enhance Bobik's handling capacity.

response.speaker: Macola
response.text: Ooh, now that would be a sight to see!

talks.objective: Follow Bobik to the lab entrance

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Ooh, Bobik's got more boxes to play with! This is gonna be awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Heh, what a fortunate child.

talks.objective: Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The door is still locked, and we haven't found the keys or anything like that. If anyone had those, it'd be Drzislav.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: But things are different now. We've retrieved our companion, haven't we?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Indeed. Bobik will most certainly be able to get this door open.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: #That said, he does listen to you the most, {NICKNAME}, so you do the honors — give the order!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bobik, show forth your power — open the door!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: That's right, Bobik! We're counting on you to get us outta here.

talks.objective: Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: #Finally, we're out! Great job, {NICKNAME}, Bobik!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: You did good too, Anezka! Really, you must teach me how to operate Bobik properly.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Haven't you read Slava's instructions front to back to front already? Shouldn't you be teaching me instead?

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: #Ah, but with you and {NICKNAME} as my tutors, I doubt I'll need those documents any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Well! As it happens, we've got a whole bunch of boxes right here. Why don't we test Bobik's recovery real quick?

talks.objective: Talk to Macola and the others
Talk to Macola and the others

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wow, Bobik's strength really has grown massively! Paimon just heard the sound of a box falling into the sea...

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Ooh, awesome! That's our Bobik, alright!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: #Thank you so much for your help, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! There's no way we could've saved Bobik on our own!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: But now he's all better, and stronger than before to boot. Next time trouble comes a-knocking, we'll be better prepared as well.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Right, didn't we say that we'd take a commemorative photo together? Things were so chaotic earlier, I almost forgot!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: That's right. We need a place with a great view, one where Bobik can also fit into the frame!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You come to a spot outside the lab with good lighting — the perfect place for a group photo.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: This place works, I'd say! So, are we ready? Let's take a picture in—

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Three, two, one, Bobi~k!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Hmm. What else will we need to bring... Ah, yes. A Macola! Can't forget that!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Hah! You speak as if I'm the type to get lost!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wow, Bobik's strength really has grown massively! Paimon just heard the sound of a box falling into the sea...

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Ooh, awesome! That's our Bobik, alright!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: #Thank you so much for your help, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! There's no way we could've saved Bobik on our own!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: But now he's all better, and stronger than before to boot. Next time trouble comes a-knocking, we'll be better prepared as well.

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Right, didn't we say that we'd take a commemorative photo together? Things were so chaotic earlier, I almost forgot!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: That's right. We need a place with a great view, one where Bobik can also fit into the frame!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You come to a spot outside the lab with good lighting — the perfect place for a group photo.

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: This place works, I'd say! So, are we ready? Let's take a picture in—

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Three, two, one, Bobi~k!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: #I can't wait to bear witness to your latest masterpiece, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Same here! Why, my eyes are ready to feast!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Would you like to rest for a while? You never know — maybe a walk's just the thing that'll net you some inspiration!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: We'll wait here for you!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: I'm worried about Bobik...

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: #He'll be fine. We've got {NICKNAME} with us — his rescue is all but guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Aaaah! Come on, let's get in there! I can't wait a moment longer!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Anezka, please, don't be rash! We must act in concert with our bosom companions, or not at all!

dialogues.speaker: Anezka
dialogues.text: Ohh, Bobik... Just wait a little longer. We're coming to save you!

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Hmm, the documentation doesn't say what the backup program module should look like...

dialogues.speaker: Macola
dialogues.text: Please, help me check the area, would you? I'll be flipping through Slava's documents. Perhaps we'll find other clues there...

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: "I've wasted twenty-six minutes today just looking for things..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Looks like I'll have to categorize my experimental supplies by serial number. Yes, my next task shall be to design a placement record table."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must've been a note that scientist guy used as a reminder to himself, right? There's something written on the back, too!

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Note to Self: If the backup program module is not to be found here, try the platform instead! You'll find a robot nearby with a pointing arrow!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the module is on <color=#00E1FFFF>a platform with a robot that has a pointing arrow</color>. Let's go see where we can find that.
